notes.title: Biggest update.
notes.notes:
A huge number of new features await you in this update. We have completely reworked the game engine, which has significantly expanded the game editor.

Added new features.

Editing the position of objects.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30902934/5b302849fbfbcc9a09f0d854c52a553a2880cada.gif

Duplication of objects.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30902934/31bcfc84625a7f029c889ec2cff25ef439b59115.gif

Dominoes added.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30902934/8c7a9232260c9850aab7e8b14fa144f5dab68600.gif

Added the ability to name marbles. (Just click on the ball to give it a name)
Finish added. When a ball with a name crosses the finish line, the time of its arrival is displayed on the 
screen.

Added bowling pins.

Added pinball bumper.

notes.title: A small update is ready.
notes.notes:
What's fixed.

1. Fixed an issue with the removal of "Interface Transparency". When the delete mode is enabled, if you select another item, the element behind the button is deleted.

2. In the delete mode, when you hover the mouse over the object, it turns red.

3. When you press the item selection button or go to the menu. The delete mode is disabled automatically.

Special thanks to the user foofaraw for his invaluable help.

notes.title: A small update is ready.
notes.notes:
What's fixed.

1. Fixed an issue with the removal of "Interface Transparency". When the delete mode is enabled, if you select another item, the element behind the button is deleted.

2. In the delete mode, when you hover the mouse over the object, it turns red.

3. When you press the item selection button or go to the menu. The delete mode is disabled automatically.

Special thanks to the user foofaraw for his invaluable help.
